Darra is a goblin who can be met at Moonrise Towers in Act Two.
“
We should never have come here.
„
— Darra

Involvement

Act Two

Darra can be found at Moonrise Towers undergoing a trial  Ketheric Thorm for her failures, if  Minthara or  Fezzerk do not survive Act One. In this case Darra is accompanied by  Drenn and  Racha.

It is not possible for the party to speak with any of the goblins outside of the cutscene. The player character has several options for deciding their fate. If the party set them free, the surviving goblins flee from Moonrise Towers and disappear.
